property_summary: For any eligible counterparty contract whose supportsToken() matches, the first airDrop always succeeds and grants exactly 20 tokens (and the hasNoBalance guard keeps it at 20 thereafter); the mutant's inverted guard makes the first call revert (balance stays 0), so the balance-equals-20 rule fails.
change_summary: Invert the hasNoBalance check so only callers with a nonzero balance can call airDrop.
